THE PRACTICAL PART

Refill. Clean. Repeat.

Release the top cap or shell at its visible latch windows. Remove the drained bottom for complete cleaning.

Use only the documented integral hanger and verify the load path. Decorative features are not alternate mounting points.

What you need

A suitable printer, compatible filament, and appropriate outdoor suspension hardware. The integral eye suspends the assembled feeder; the cord or support is not a printed part. No camera, batteries, app or subscription are needed.

Supplied 3MF filament type: PETG. ASA is an outdoor alternative, not a drop-in profile substitution: change the profile, re-slice and test the fit. Use manufacturer ventilation guidance.

Download editable source ZIP

Assembly sequence

  1. Press mating parts together until both hooks click into their receiver windows.
  2. Check every visible hook is fully engaged. Pull-test over a soft surface before hanging.
  3. For cleaning, unload and press accessible snap beams inward through receiver windows; separate mating components.

Part-specific support notes

  • Seed floor
    Orient broad planar mating face on bed; support curved overhangs. Keep snap beams free of support.
  • Chin and service frame

Before hanging it outdoors

  • R2 digital engineering prototype; snap retention, fatigue, weathering and bird use have not been physically tested.
  • Outdoor ASA or PETG, 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.20 mm layers, 4 walls. Print snap beams lengthwise in XY where practical; trial-print joint coupon first.
  • All connections use positive 0.8 mm hooked cantilevers and open release windows; 0.30 mm clearance per side. One metal hanger attaches only to the assembled integral eye.
  • Drainage holes are integral. Release snap windows to remove the seed floor and roof for washing; dry fully before refill.

Use shallow daily portions, remove wet seed, keep drains open, and inspect joints and suspension points. Test near the ground before installing over people, pets or property.
